notes: Lead origin: inbound from Shopify app marketplace listing (contact form). Small direct-to-consumer apparel brand. Wants a lightweight product Q&A widget on PDPs and an internal tool to auto-generate product descriptions and tags (catalog enrichment). Key points from calls: - Primary constraint: cost sensitivity; they expect bursty traffic during weekend drops and holiday promos (spikes x6-8). - Wants Hosted API (self-serve) first; prefers public cloud, no on-prem plans today. - Latency target: <300ms 95p for product Q&A widget; acceptable fallbacks to cached responses for cold starts. - Model preference: open to smaller generation models for Q&A, embeddings for similarity; interested in Redwood's model profiles and recommendations for quantized variants. - Security: SOC2 compliance is required by their payments/partners; asked about audit logs and token-level cost visibility. - Integration: Shopify (Liquid) + small serverless layer to proxy calls. Asked for example code and cost estimate per 100k queries/month with burst headroom. - Quote from founder: "Our conversion drop on slow pages is real — we need answers fast, but we can't eat cloud bills." - POC plan: spike with Hosted API for 2 weeks, evaluate latency/cost, then consider Dedicated if predictable high-throughput emerges.
